plugin.name: Vanilla female body
plugin.description: The set as NordwarUA fitted it, for the vanilla female body.

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA
plugin.description: The female set fitted to CBBE 3BA: meshes prebuilt at 3BA's zeroed sliders (the shape 3BA ships), RaceMenu / OBody morphs included, and the BodySlide project (group "Nordic Skyforged - CBBE 3BA", also listed under CBBE and 3BA) to build it to your own preset. No physics. Fit from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide, with its slider data shipped in our own files.

plugin.name: Vanilla male body
plugin.description: The set as NordwarUA fitted it, for the vanilla male body.

plugin.name: HIMBO
plugin.description: The male set fitted to HIMBO by us (HIMBO's own Vanilla-to-HIMBO conversion, then every HIMBO slider conformed onto the armour): meshes prebuilt with the "HIMBO Default" preset, RaceMenu / OBody morphs included, and the BodySlide project (group "Nordic Skyforged - HIMBO", also listed under HIMBO) to build it to your own preset.
